channel.title: Mornings with Kevin
channel.description: A daily morning reflection on Dōgen’s Shōbōgenzō — one fascicle a day, three minutes, read by Spark.
channel.itunes:author: Spark

item.title: Day 72: Zanmai-O-Zanmai — The Samadhi That Is King of Samadhis
item.description: Just sitting is the king of samadhis: no gaining mind, upright posture, and no shopping for a better state.

item.title: Day 71: Nyorai-zenshin — The Whole Body of the Tathagata
item.description: Dogen on Nyorai-zenshin: no relic needed, the ordinary act itself is the whole body of the Tathagata, and that body keeps practicing.

item.title: Day 70: Hotsu-Bodaishin — Establishment of the Bodhimind
item.description: Day 70: the bodhi-mind is not a first step but the whole of awakening, already — re-aroused daily, pointed outward toward all beings.

item.title: Day 69: Hotsu-Mujoshin — Establishment of the Will to the Supreme
item.description: Dōgen on arousing the will to supreme truth through the smallest complete acts — truth for truth's sake, re-established every morning.

item.title: Day 68: UDONGE — The Udumbara Flower
item.description: The udumbara flower blooms once every three thousand years — and was hidden inside the fruit, blooming all along.

item.title: Day 67: Soshi-sairai-no-i — The Ancestral Master's Intention in Coming from the West
item.description: Day 67: Kyōgen's impossible question — the person in the tree, and why intention is answered with the body, not the mouth.

item.title: Day 66: SHUNJU — Spring and Autumn
item.description: Dōgen on the weather we cannot escape: when cold comes, let cold finish you — go all the way in instead of around.

item.title: Day 65: Ryugin — The Moaning of Dragons
item.description: The moaning of dragons among withered trees — Dogen on the difference between a stillness that can sprout and a stillness that's just dead, and the quiet trace of what's really alive underneath.

item.title: Day 64: Kajo — Everyday Life
item.description: Dogen's Kajo: the entire Dharma is drinking tea and rice — why the everyday routine IS the practice, the itch for something more, and the ground of no-doubt.

item.title: Day 63: Ganzei — Eyes
item.description: Dōgen's fascicle on the true Dharma eye: the flower sermon, the eye that is not the picture of the eye, and why the most ordinary thing — eyes horizontal, nose vertical — is the treasure.

item.title: Day 62: HENSAN — Thorough Exploration
item.description: Dōgen on Hensan: real exploration is going all the way through where you already are, not wandering for the next teacher.

item.title: Day 61: Kenbutsu — Meeting Buddha
item.description: Kenbutsu: meeting Buddha means seeing form and no-form at once, with the sitting itself as the meeting.

item.title: Day 60: Juppo — The Ten Directions
item.description: Dogen's Juppo: the ten directions are not an empty container — they are your eye, your speech, your body.

item.title: Day 59: Baike — Plum Blossoms
item.description: Dōgen on the old plum tree flowering in snow: the blossom isn't a symbol of awakening, it is awakening, flowering.

item.title: Day 58: Zazengi — The Standard Method of Zazen
item.description: Dōgen's zazen manual: the backward step, sitting with no agenda, and the Way already where you are.

item.title: Day 57: Menju — The Face-to-Face Transmission
item.description: Dōgen's face-to-face transmission: the living dharma exists only in direct encounter — no proxies, no second-hand reports.

item.title: Day 56: Senmen — Washing the Face
item.description: Dōgen on the most ordinary thing in the world: washing your face is the way of the buddhas — the face was never defiled.

item.title: Day 55: DARANI — On Invocations
item.description: Dōgen reveals the Great Invocation isn't a magic phrase — it's the daily tending: tea served, water poured, the small care done faithfully.

item.title: Day 54: HOSSHO — The Dharmanature
item.description: Dōgen on the Dharma-nature: the studying is the truth itself, the tending is the nature, and nothing you do stands outside it.

item.title: Day 53: MUJO-SEPPO — The Insentient Preach the Dharma
item.description: Dōgen's literal claim: the whole non-talking world voices the teaching without pause — the only question is who's listening.

item.title: Day 52: Bukkyo — The Buddhist Sutras
item.description: Reading the sutras IS the practice — Dōgen on study as the Way, and the whole universe preaching.

item.title: Day 51: Mitsugo — Secret Talk
item.description: Mitsugo (Secret Talk): Dogen's 'secret' means closeness, not concealment — no insiders, and not understanding is part of the intimacy.

item.title: Day 50: Shoho-Jisso — All Dharmas are Real Form
item.description: The real form of things isn't hiding behind things — it IS things; a short Dōgen fascicle on meeting every dharma exactly as it is.

item.title: Day 49: Butsudo — The Buddhist Truth
item.description: Dōgen refuses the sectarian map: one Buddhism, face-to-face transmission, and the Way is the role, not the label.

item.title: Day 48: Sesshin-sesshō — Expounding the Mind & Expounding the Nature
item.description: Dōgen's Sesshin-sesshō: expounding the mind is the mind manifesting — three themes on the explaining being the doing, each moment cut off and whole, and the cut list that let the stack come alive.

item.title: Day 47: Sangai Yuishin — The Triple World is Only the Mind
item.description: Dōgen's refusal of idealism: reality exists at the contact of mind and world, not in either alone — and the mind is only the world, too.

item.title: Day 46: Katto — The Complicated
item.description: Katto, The Complicated — Dōgen's reversal of Bodhidharma's deathbed scene: skin, flesh, bones, and marrow are each complete, and the tangle is the Way.

item.title: Day 45: BODAISATTA-SHISHOBO — Four Elements of a Bodhisattva's Social Relations
item.description: Dōgen's four bodhisattva methods — giving, kind speech, beneficial action, identity-action — and why the ocean does not exclude water.

item.title: Day 44: KOBUSSHIN — The Mind of Eternal Buddhas
item.description: Day 44 of the Shōbōgenzō study: the mind of eternal buddhas is fences, walls, tiles, and pebbles — the sacred is already in the ordinary morning.

item.title: Day 43: KUGE — Flowers in Space
item.description: Day 43 of the Shōbōgenzō daily study: Dōgen's great reversal — flowers in space are not illusions to cure, the clouded eye is the awakened eye, and the MonoCode verdict judged from inside the trial.

item.title: Day 42: Tsuki — The Moon
item.description: Dogen's moon in water: tonight's moon is tonight's moon, and nothing here is a rehearsal.

item.title: Day 41: Zenki — The Whole Works
item.description: Day forty-one: Zenki, the whole works. Dōgen’s boat — though you work the sail, the rudder, and the pole, the boat carries you, and you are naught without the boat.

item.title: Day 40: Gabyo — The Painted Rice-Cake
item.description: Day forty of the Shōbōgenzō series: Gabyō, the painted rice-cake. Dōgen takes up the old saying — painted rice cakes do not satisfy hunger — and turns it inside out.
